confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from one search of the RBA exchange-rates overview, which showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced aggregates (Numbeo, Expat Exchange, Tripbase, Nomad.watch). Those sources put beer at about 80 THB, cappuccino at about 59 THB, an inexpensive meal at 40-100 THB, and a mid-range meal for two at about 650 THB. They gave little cocktail data, so the cocktail is estimated at about 2x beer, using Tripbase's roughly $3.50 as a cross-check. Wine by the glass is inferred from a roughly 550 THB bottle price plus a restaurant markup. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Prices in Pai vary with the season and between tourist and local venues.
comparable_city_reasoning: Northern Thailand backpacker towns such as Chiang Mai outskirts and Pai itself, with budget-oriented tourism pricing.
